name: Personal Information Storage and Security Guardrail
what_it_decides: Requires personal identifiable information (PII) to be protected against unauthorized access, use, modification, or disclosure through storage encryption.

name: Tax Invoice Threshold and Buyer Details Rule
standard: Goods and Services Tax Act 1985 Section 24
what_it_decides: Mandates that taxable supply transactions exceeding NZD 1,000 must include full tax invoice details (seller and buyer GST registration numbers).

name: Privileged Access Identity and Authentication Control
standard: New Zealand Information Security Manual (NZISM v3.8) Section 16.1.1
what_it_decides: Enforces identity verification and multi-factor authentication for automated administrative or privileged infrastructure actions.

name: Automated Decisions Human Oversight and Audit Standard
what_it_decides: Requires human review and audit logging for high-impact automated operational and customer risk decisions.
